reuse.why: The link guard is one shared assertBankAccountLinkable used by every provider and findOrCreateBank/syncAccount/handleSyncResponse are reused, but the unlink field reset is rewritten instead of being extracted from unlinkAccount, and Fintegra is added by copying Akahu's link and download functions.

duplication.why: linkFintegraAccount is a near-verbatim copy of linkAkahuAccount, downloadFintegraTransactions copies downloadAkahuTransactions, and releaseAccountLinks repeats unlinkAccount's db.updateAccount reset block.

placement.why: The guard and link functions sit in accounts/app.ts next to the provider link handlers, the download in accounts/sync.ts and the URL in server-config.ts, matching the tree's layering.

scope.why: Changes serve the four steps; the small desktop-client edits are needed to satisfy the extended provider union rather than unrelated work.

maintainability.why: Link rules are centralised in one guard, but each new provider adds another ~80-line copy and the unlink reset now lives in two places that can drift.

abstraction_drift.where: assertBankAccountLinkable gains upgradingId and replaceExistingLink parameters and a closed-target branch; all six provider link functions (including the new Fintegra one) call it and releaseAccountLinks in the same order.
